$Comment: The oath set: the one file that says how Focuses are sworn. A Focus's steps are bought once and kept for good,
but what they grant, the signature they open and every number they add count only while that Focus is sworn
here, held in one of these slots. Each Focus's Vow is its face (its Stance names no other face); its Path,
Signature and Honed steps name the Vow as their Face, so they live while it is held. The steps come from
TrackPickGenerators/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Focus_Steps.json over one row a Focus (GeneratorRows/MMOSkillTree/Focus).
Slots: I is open from the start; II opens while the player owns Mmo_Focus_Slot_II, the key the trainer's
Second Oath quest teaches. A third oath is one more row with its own condition (a Requires, a Pick, or both).
Kinds: Max is the most Focuses of a kind sworn at once whatever slots are open (one weapon, two elements, one
Bulwark), so a hit only ever takes one Focus's line; WhileHeld is what an oath costs the body while it stands,
once per Focus of that kind sworn, and comes back the moment it is broken: a weapon 25 max Health, an element
50 max Mana, the Bulwark a true tenth of every hit its holder deals (DamageDealt -10: each hit, of any type, is
multiplied by 0.9 after every other bonus). Never Stamina.
Hold is free (unwritten); Break, releasing a sworn Focus by choice, costs 500 Essence of Life, refused in a fight
or an encounter. A Focus released because its slot closed or its steps were cleared is released free.
Where: swearing and breaking happen at the Mastery Trainer, at whichever standing is switched on.
Budget: the most one Focus's live grants may add, read by the stance audit (STANCE_FACE_OVER_BUDGET) and the
pack's budget test: 25 on the Combat family (the damage and resistance stats; an either-or at its larger face)
and 40 Health. What swearing costs (WhileHeld) is not counted.
An owner retunes any of it on the Track Stances screen (/zigadmin), which writes
mods/ziggfreedcommon/track-stances.json under Mmo_Focus: a kind written there merges into this one leaf by leaf.
